contea di ritrovamento: Suffolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete silver Early Medieval (Anglo-Saxon) sceat, dating to AD 665-685 ( Vanimundus series Va). Obverse depicting helmeted bust right, elaborate drapery, holding sceptre behind, legend around [...]S, pellets in the field. Reverse depicting Greek cross in double beaded inner circle, incomplete legend reading [...] MVS. Cf Abramson (2006, p. 63, VaB, type 55). EMC 2020.0260
